_label: S007 Phases 3-4. What changed so that OBSERVE -> HYPOTHESIZE -> DISCRIMINATE -> ACT -> VERIFY is a reachable state transition, and so that a HEAD move in HCLI's tree is attributable. The repair changes HOW the loop runs; it never says WHAT to fix.
_evidence: MEASURED. Each repair has a RED that failed before it and a GREEN after, the load-bearing line of each was mutation-checked (disabled -> the test fails -> restored, hash-verified), and the isolation claim was proved on a live commit rather than argued.

S007_PROHIBITIONS_HONOURED.no_hardcoded_defect_for_hcli: the body still chooses its own file, hypothesis, discriminator and edit. The phase machine refuses to let 'I will read more' be a valid answer forever; it never names a target. The three candidate deficiencies Claude found during experiment 1 remain UNSPENT and were deliberately not handed over.
S007_PROHIBITIONS_HONOURED.no_fabricated_RED: the only REDs written were for Claude's OWN two repairs, against real captured bytes from the run. No RED was manufactured on HCLI's behalf.
S007_PROHIBITIONS_HONOURED.no_auto_created_edit: nothing writes a repo.edit for the body. A cycle with no edit is recorded as FAILED, which is the opposite of papering over it.
S007_PROHIBITIONS_HONOURED.claudes_repair_does_not_count_as_G004: explicit in the ledger amendment; G004 requires the body's own 10-step arc landing through hcli/landing.py, whose AUTHORSHIP_TRAILER is the mechanical proof.
S007_PROHIBITIONS_HONOURED.no_new_framework_or_mythology: no new module, class, subsystem or gate. The phase machine is ~90 lines inside the existing harness; the fs.read repair is 22 lines inside an existing handler.

REPAIR_1_fs_read_tells_the_truth.defect: fs.read(path, start_line=1620, end_line=1720) on a 247-line file returned ok=True, content="", truncated=False, start_line=1620, end_line=247 -- failure reported as success, with coordinates that contradict themselves.
REPAIR_1_fs_read_tells_the_truth.why_truncated_could_not_carry_it: `truncated` answers 'was content cut?' and past EOF the honest answer is no -- there was nothing to cut. The WINDOW is the thing that is wrong, so it now reports itself: out_of_range plus a note naming the file's real length and the window that does not exist.
REPAIR_1_fs_read_tells_the_truth.cost_in_experiment_1: cycle 47 emitted a runaway stream of reads walking a 247-line file toward line 1720 until the generation died; cycles 52-66 (fifteen consecutive) went into one file the body believed it had never finished reading, because no read could ever contradict the belief.
REPAIR_1_fs_read_tells_the_truth.RED: 2 new tests failed before the fix: an out-of-range window carried no out_of_range flag and no note, and reported end_line(247) before start_line(1620).
REPAIR_1_fs_read_tells_the_truth.GREEN: 8/8 in hcli/tests/test_fs_read_window.py, including a negative control that an in-range read is NOT flagged.
REPAIR_1_fs_read_tells_the_truth.mutation_check: forcing out_of_range = False fails exactly those 2 tests and nothing else; source restored and verified by sha256; zero markers left behind.
REPAIR_1_fs_read_tells_the_truth.regression: controlled comparison, same suite, same tree, with and without the fix: 61 failed baseline vs 59 with it; set-diff shows ZERO tests failing that did not already fail. The '53' figure quoted earlier in the campaign was a STALE baseline from a different selection -- measuring the contemporaneous baseline in the worktree is what made the +6 scare evaporate.

REPAIR_2_the_loop_can_now_fail.file: .hcli/selfdev/harness.py (gitignored: durable operational state, not shipped source)
REPAIR_2_the_loop_can_now_fail.defect: no cycle could fail. A reply with no hypothesis, no test and no edit was a well-formed chat completion, logged as 'reachable 11/11', 66 times.

change.phase_machine: ORIENT -> HYPOTHESIS_REQUIRED -> DISCRIMINATOR_REQUIRED -> ACT_REQUIRED -> VERIFY, persisted in the `phase` field that already existed and had only ever held 'developing'. A cycle that does not produce what its phase demands increments failed_cycles and its failure is named back to the body verbatim next cycle.
change.advance_only_on_evidence: ACT is satisfied ONLY by the server's own executed-tool trace showing repo.edit -- never by prose. Cycle 66 of experiment 1 contained the literal words 'repo.edit', echoed from its own objective, while calling nothing; that exact string is now a negative control in the self-check.
change.attempt_vs_success_kept_apart: a repo.edit the engine REJECTED hands back the engine's real error rather than 'you produced no repo.edit call' -- which would be false, and would make the body re-send the same broken arguments forever.
change.commitments_survive: the chosen hypothesis and discriminator are carried into the next prompt verbatim. Experiment 1 fed the next cycle a regex-scraped TAIL of the previous reply, and 49 of 66 replies were truncated before their tail, so whatever the body decided evaporated between cycles.
change.markers_at_the_head: required markers are read from the first lines only. Generation is left-to-right: a marker at the front survives a truncated reply, one at the tail does not. A tail-only marker is a self-check case and must NOT satisfy a phase.
change.stuck_detector: 4 consecutive failures in one phase logs a loud STUCK line telling the supervisor to re-diagnose rather than accumulate cycles -- S007's own instruction not to wait another 65.

REPAIR_2_the_loop_can_now_fail.incidental_fix_measured: the old prompt's phrase 'Your planned next action' satisfied chat_state.asked_for_a_plan() (substring 'plan' inside 'planned' + a trigger verb), spawning 65 draft plans in 70 turns, none reaching status:executing. The restructured prompt triggers it on 0 of 5 phases -- verified by calling asked_for_a_plan() on each rendered phase prompt. One word mattered: 'explanation' had to become 'prose', because ex-PLAN-ation matches the same substring. The underlying heuristic bug in hcli/chat_state.py was deliberately LEFT for HCLI: it is on the candidate-deficiency list and fixing it would be shaping the body's own internals.
REPAIR_2_the_loop_can_now_fail.self_check: python3.12 .hcli/selfdev/harness.py --selfcheck -- covers advance-on-evidence, fail-on-prose, rejected-vs-absent edits, truncation resistance, and the 8 known false-positive HEAD ranges. Mutation-checked: forcing the act-detector to True fails the prose negative control.

REPAIR_3_two_writers_two_trees.why: all 9 'HEAD MOVED (edit accepted)' events in experiment 1 were Claude commits landing mid-cycle. The trailer check fixed the MEASUREMENT; this removes the CONTAMINATION.
REPAIR_3_two_writers_two_trees.harness_split: ROOT (the tree HCLI edits, where its HEAD moves) is now the worktree; CAMPAIGN (the supervisor record -- objective, checkpoint, evidence, metrics) stays canonical in the primary checkout so it survives and stays readable whatever happens to the worktree.
REPAIR_3_two_writers_two_trees.runtime_isolation_verified: RepoContext.detect() from inside the worktree resolves to the WORKTREE root, not the primary -- checked explicitly, because a git worktree's .git is a FILE and a detector that required a directory would have escaped upward and failed silently. The live surface's own /health reports repo = the worktree.
REPAIR_3_two_writers_two_trees.PROVED_ON_A_LIVE_COMMIT: an Odyssey commit moved main a00ea4048 -> 4c7cfc71e while the selfdev worktree HEAD stayed at a00ea4048. Any HEAD move in HCLI's tree is now attributable to HCLI.
REPAIR_3_two_writers_two_trees.odyssey_ownership: the primary checkout is Claude's Odyssey tree with Claude as sole writer. S007 requires the two writers be isolated, not that a third checkout be minted -- one writer per tree is satisfied without redundant disk.
